author: Astrokillah
text:
Mukhcin wrote: yesterdays small scalp?@_@?

Hello Mukhcin,

I enjoyed reading your journal This EURUSD trade you took caught my eye, I hope you don't mind me asking a few questions?

What are the significance of the two dotted lines (labelled 1 and 2) below?

I had a look at this chart, and on H1 timeframe, here's what I saw: FL-A is engulfed by FL-B, and then FL-C engulfed FL-B.

Then on 15-min chart, I see that FL-E is created after engulfing FL-C.

The part that I have not been able to figure out is, what makes FL-E an
important one? Is it because it engulfed FL-C? But then what makes C an
important one?

Thank you very much for your time.

AK

author: Mukhcin
text:
nothing to say about boxes) everything is right, at least in my
opinion). what makes last FL important is only the MPL. why i wrote
highest scale, lower scale, and lowest scale, if you look deeper to 1m
chart you can see FL within FL and at the mpl of last FL you can find
qm. IF says, trade the extremes, and look for the tricks. last week i
had eureka moment. i decided to trade only mpl, and guess what? this
week i didn' have any loosing trade yet.wish it helps, and thanks for
comments.

 PS. those lines are the zones which held price up.
